name: eevee-shadow-pool-stress
purpose: Verify Eevee shadow pool expansion with a 257-light scene that exceeds 2048 MB but fits in 4096 MB and 8192 MB on hardware that can allocate the requested atlas.
passCriteria: The 2048 MB control render must report a shadow buffer full warning. The 4096 MB and 8192 MB renders must complete without shadow buffer full warnings and without shadow atlas allocation downgrade warnings.
